children: The group that oversees $250 bln of private assets named TPG's Todd Sisitsky as co-CEO alongside internal pick Peter Rutland. External hires are rare in the sector, and risky for a firm with a unique culture. Still, the buyout veteran can help CVC fill a critical gap in the US.
Full view will be published shortly.
Follow Liam Proud on Bluesky and LinkedIn.
CVC Capital on September 9 said that Todd Sisitsky and Peter Rutland will become co-CEOs by the first quarter of 2028.
TPG, the American private-capital group, said on September 8 that Sisitsky had notified the company of his decision to step down as president effective immediately.
Rutland has been with CVC for 19 years, and is currently a managing partner and president with responsibility for credit and insurance, secondary investments and infrastructure.
